title: Cushman & Wakefield appoints Bram Coops as Head of Corporate & Client Finance, Asset Services
summary: Cushman & Wakefield has appointed Bram Coops as Head of Corporate & Client Finance within its Asset Services team.
body_markdown:
**[Amsterdam](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/netherlands/offices/amsterdam) , 3 November 2026** – Cushman & Wakefield has appointed Bram Coops as Head of Corporate & Client Finance within its[Asset Services](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/netherlands/services/asset-services) team. Coops joined on 1 October and will take over the responsibilities and team from Frans Breedijk as of 1 January 2027, when Breedijk retires. Bram Coops has been appointed Partner and will join the Asset Services Management Team.


Coops brings more than 25 years of experience in finance, business control, audit and project management. He has held senior finance positions at companies including LivePerson, Bristol-Myers Squibb, Kloosterboer, BCD Travel and PwC. Since 2015, he has worked as an independent interim Finance & Project Manager for organisations including Morgan Stanley Real Estate Funds and Merin.


Within the real estate sector, Coops has gained extensive experience in the implementation and optimisation of Yardi, as well as in developing financial processes and reporting. In 2022, for example, he implemented Yardi for Dream Industrial REIT in the Netherlands in preparation for a wider European roll-out.


Over the coming months, Bram Coops will work closely with[Frans Breedijk](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/netherlands/people/frans-breedijk) to ensure a smooth and careful transition.


[Arjen Boesveldt](https://www.cushmanwakefield.com/en/netherlands/people/arjen-boesveldt) , Head of Asset Services at Cushman & Wakefield:


Bram brings experience in both the financial management of international organisations and the systems and processes that underpin real estate portfolios. This combination is a strong fit with Corporate & Client Finance within our Asset Services business. We are delighted to welcome him and pleased to have the opportunity to ensure a smooth and carefully managed transition with Frans.
